newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen FY97 estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen FY97 estimate raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc Friday raised its estimate for Amgen Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $2.77 a share from $2.71, citing its belief the company will continue to buy back its shares with any cash it has on its balance sheet above $1.0 billion.
-- EVEREN also raised its estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings to $2.98 from $2.91, although it said it continues to be concerned about a slowdown in Epogen and Neupogen sales.
-- Amgen is a biotechnology development company.
-- Its shares closed up 1-1/4 Friday at 56-1/4.
